description: Same-app window cycling, one-key snapping, and mouse button mapping for Windows 11.
notes: This installer requires Administrator and installs to %ProgramFiles%\Wira Desk - it is NOT a portable app, unlike most Scoop packages. `scoop install` will trigger a UAC prompt.
Auto-start is prompted during onboarding with a pre-checked option. Manage it from the tray menu or Settings app.
`scoop uninstall` runs the same uninstaller Add/Remove Programs would. It leaves %APPDATA%\WiraDesk untouched - see the project README for factory reset.
